extracted.name: Gherkin ketchup
extracted.description: This tangy ketchup delivers maximum flavour for minimum effort. It’s just blitzed-up gherkins, but your guests will think you’re a pickling genius
instruction_lines: Tip all the ingredients into a pan. Bring to the boil and simmer for 10-15 mins until almost all of the liquid has evaporated. Pour the gherkins into a blender and purée until smooth. Then pass through a fine sieve and chill in the fridge. Can be made up to five days ahead, just give it a stir before serving. Best served at room temperature.
